In this lexicon

  • dare

    the recommended word · classical · Verg. A. 6.14–15: Daedalus … ausus sē crēdere caelō; Hor. Ep. 1.2.40: sapere audē

Examples

  • dīmidium factī, quī coepit, habet; sapere audē, incipe

    well begun is half done: dare to be wise, make a startHor. Ep. 1.2.40–41
